claims.evidence: Original: "Methotrexate is an immunosuppressant ..." | Retrieved: NHS: immunosuppressant for RA, psoriasis, Crohn's; sometimes cancer.
claims.newSentence: Methotrexate is an immunosuppressant used for inflammatory conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis and Crohn's disease, and sometimes for cancer.

claims.evidence: Original: "The NHS says it calms the immune system to help stop it attacking the body's own cells." | Retrieved: NHS: calms/slows the immune system and reduces inflammation.
claims.newSentence: The NHS says it calms the immune system and helps reduce inflammation.

claims.evidence: Original: "Methotrexate blocks dihydrofolate reductase, an enzyme needed to make the active form of folic acid used to build DNA and RNA." | Retrieved: Reviews: DHFR inhibition; tetrahydrofolate; DNA/RNA synthesis.
claims.newSentence: Methotrexate blocks an enzyme called dihydrofolate reductase, which the body uses to make tetrahydrofolate, a form of folate needed to build DNA and RNA.

claims.evidence: Original: "In inflammatory conditions, how low-dose methotrexate works is less clear." | Retrieved: Reviews: low-dose anti-inflammatory mechanism less clear.
claims.newSentence: In inflammatory conditions, how low-dose methotrexate works is less clear.

claims.evidence: Original: "Taking methotrexate daily by mistake instead of weekly has led to overdoses that were sometimes fatal." | Retrieved: MHRA/MedlinePlus: daily-for-weekly mistake caused fatal overdose.
claims.newSentence: Taking it daily by mistake instead of weekly has caused overdoses that were sometimes fatal.

claims.evidence: Original: "The MHRA introduced new measures in 2020 ... including a patient card." | Retrieved: MHRA Sept 2020: new measures including patient card.
claims.newSentence: The MHRA introduced new measures in 2020 to reduce this risk, including a patient card for oral products.

claims.evidence: Original: "Regular blood tests are used to monitor treatment." | Retrieved: Versus Arthritis / NHS: regular blood tests.
claims.newSentence: Regular blood tests are used to monitor treatment.

claims.evidence: Original: "The NHS says methotrexate is not recommended in pregnancy, as it can cause birth defects." | Retrieved: NHS: not recommended in pregnancy; birth defects.
claims.newSentence: The NHS says methotrexate is not recommended in pregnancy because it can cause birth defects.

claims.evidence: Original: "NSAIDs can raise the risk of kidney toxicity, so they are used with caution on specialist advice." | Retrieved: SPS: NSAIDs raise methotrexate toxicity risk; 'kidney toxicity' not confirmed.
claims.newSentence: NSAIDs can increase the risk of methotrexate toxicity, so they are used only on specialist advice.

claims.evidence: Original: "Trimethoprim and co-trimoxazole are advised against because of the risk of severe bone marrow suppression." | Retrieved: SPS/Scottish guidance: avoid; additive antifolate effect and bone marrow suppression.
claims.newSentence: Trimethoprim and co-trimoxazole are advised against because of the risk of severe bone marrow suppression.

claims.evidence: Original: "Live vaccines are avoided." | Retrieved: SPS/hospital guidance: live vaccines not recommended.
claims.newSentence: Live vaccines are not recommended during treatment.

claims.evidence: Original: "Taking methotrexate daily by mistake ... (classWarning)" | Retrieved: MHRA/MedlinePlus: daily-for-weekly mistake caused fatal overdose.
claims.newSentence: Taking it daily by mistake instead of weekly has caused overdoses that were sometimes fatal.
